capabilities: create a note from a Wikipedia article
extras: README is minimal: a one-line description plus a usage code example, with no details on output format or options. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and the author calls it 'not perfect'.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a Wikipedia article into a note in the vault.
summary: Converter that creates an Obsidian note from a Wikipedia article.
